What s the role
As a Senior Functional Analyst Finance, you will join the IDT Engineering team, delivering business value by providing top-tier technical, functional, and consulting expertise. In this role, you ll contribute to IT projects, programs, and products across Shell s value chain, with a strong focus on S/4 PaPM. You ll have opportunities for personal growth through learning and certifications, and you ll be part of a community that nurtures technical talent and business knowledge. Your responsibilities will include identifying and documenting business needs for clients and stakeholders, ensuring the right skills are delivered at the right time and place.
What you ll be doing
  • Deliver SAP Profitability and Performance Management (SAP PaPM) solutions by translating business and process requirements into technical specifications.
  • Perform system configurations while ensuring adherence to build standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with Process Architects and Design Authorities to develop IT solutions aligned with business needs
  • Work closely with Lead Business Analysts and Process Experts to design complex solution specifications.
  • Conduct unit testing and support integration testing for applicable solutions.
  • Undertake problem analysis to identify root causes of incidents, escalating findings within the Line and Business, to minimize such incidents re-occurring
  • Drive resolution of defects during test cycles and hyper care as well as for critical incidents.
  • Define and safeguard IT solutions to ensure they are robust, scalable, and supportable, with proper documentation prepared for CAB meetings.
  • Recommend functional improvements to existing solutions.
  • Maintain a detailed functional understanding of the application/module and its role in supporting business processes.
  • Ensure that all changes are properly and extensively documented.
  • Fully comply with all Group IT standards and processes.
What you bring
  • 9-12 years of overall functional experience.
  • At least 8 years of hands-on experience in ECC and S/4HANA Controlling module configuration, with a solid understanding of related business processes.
  • 1 2 end-to-end implementations in SAP Profitability and Performance Management (SAP PaPM).
  • Strong expertise in S/4HANA Controlling, including CCA, PCA, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, and Material Ledger.
  • Solid domain knowledge in Accounting and Cost Accounting.
  • Experience in defining data models in PaPM, integrating with SAP and non-SAP systems, and designing business rules using standard PaPM capabilities.
  • Understanding of cost and revenue allocation process design and implementation.
  • Functional knowledge and experience in financial allocation processes.
  • Strong grasp of integration points between CO and other modules such as FI, SD, PP, and MM.
  • Familiarity with Direct Tax is a plus.
  • Experience with SAP BW, SAP HANA, or SAP BPC is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of S/4HANA integration with other modules is beneficial.
  • Well-versed in S/4HANA system implementation methodologies.
  • Commitment to meeting customer requirements and expectations, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
What we offer
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another.   • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase our pay and benefits packages are among the best in the world.

Shell in India
Shell is a diversified energy company in India with 13,000 employees, and presence in Integrated Gas, Downstream, Power, Renewable and Upstream. Additionally, we have deep capabilities in RD, digitalization, and business operations.
Our global strategy, Powering Progress, is designed to generate value for our shareholders, customers, and the wider society, and focuses on creating more value with less emissions. The strategy supports our purpose of providing more and cleaner energy solutions, with the aim of profitably transforming Shell into a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050. As India moves towards its target of net-zero emissions by 2070, Shell India aims to play a leading role in securing vital energy for today, while investing in, and helping to build, the energy system of the future through strategic investments in the country.
Our Lubricants business serves over 50,000 consumers through a strong network of over 200 distributors, and operates an end-to-end value chain that spans conceptualization, development, and production at a world-class blending plant at Taloja. Through our 350-plus retail stations, we offer an integrated mobility experience including fuels, cafes, and convenience stores, with a prominent network of EV recharging facilities.
Shell owns and operates an LNG re-gasification terminal at Hazira, Surat, with a capacity of 5 MTPA and an LNG truck-loading unit that plays a crucial role in helping meet India s growing demand for gas across sectors. In 2022, Shell acquired Spring Energy in a $1.55 billion deal to build an integrated energy transition business in the country. Spring is a leading renewable energy company in India which develops and manages solar, wind, and hybrid power generation facilities and infrastructure.
Our three capability centers across Bangalore and Chennai serve as a technology and innovation powerhouse for Shell globally, working as a delivery engine for core technical, digital, and finance processes: pioneering digital innovation and cutting-edge technologies across the energy sector. We also have strong academic partnerships and collaborations with leading universities and technology institutes to accelerate decarbonization efforts within the energy sector.
We are committed to positively contributing to the communities in which we operate through programs on STEM Education, Skilling, and Livelihood across India. We nurture and invest in startups developing initiatives focused on accelerating energy innovation through programs such as Shell E4 and Shell Eco-marathon. We also have strategic investments in new energy companies such as Husk Power, d.light, Orb Energy, and Cleantech Solar.

This role will be critical in ensuring our SAP C4C landscape supports strategic business goals, drives efficiency, and enhances customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural design, development, and implementation of SAP C4C solutions, encompassing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Marketing Cloud modules.
  • Collaborate extensively with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate complex business requirements into detailed system specifications and functional designs for SAP C4C.
  • Design end-to-end SAP C4C solutions, including configuration, custom development (SDK), UI adaptations, and reporting, ensuring alignment with overall enterprise architecture and best practices.
  • Define and oversee the integration strategy for SAP C4C with other critical systems, including SAP ECC/S/4HANA, SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration), SAP PI/PO, and other third-party applications, ensuring seamless data flow and process automation.
  • Provide expert technical guidance, mentorship, and leadership to development and functional teams, ensuring adherence to architectural standards, quality, and performance.
  • Ensure the optimal performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability of SAP C4C solutions. Conduct system analysis, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements.

  • Create comprehensive solution documentation, including architectural blueprints, functional specifications, technical designs, test plans, and deployment strategies.
  • Lead and facilitate workshops, fit-gap analysis, and design sessions with business users and technical teams.
  • Stay abreast of the latest SAP C4C features, product roadmaps, industry trends, and emerging technologies (e.g., AI, predictive analytics within C4C) to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Provide architectural input for project planning, effort estimation, risk assessment, and technical feasibility studies. Support go-live and post-production activities.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with other SAP CX (Customer Experience) solutions
  • Knowledge of ABAP development for integration scenarios with SAP ECC/S/4HANA.

jobDescription:
Role & responsibilities


  • Plan and execute daily cut-to-length orders on industrial bandsaw machines; create basic nesting to minimize scrap, choose appropriate blades, and set feed/speed for dimensional accuracy and surface finish.
  • Supervise safe loading/unloading and in-yard movement of bars, plates, and bundles using EOT cranes; enforce rigging standards, hand signals, pre-use checklists, and bay discipline.
  • Maintain stock locations and traceability by heat/lot numbers; verify markings, tally lengths/weights, and update issue/receipt records to prevent grade mix-ups.
  • Coordinate dispatch readiness: final inspections, bundling/strapping, tagging/labels, documentation handover, and on-time truck turnarounds with basic gate coordination.
  • Own first-line maintenance for bandsaws and cranes: lubrication, coolant/fluids, blade changes, filter checks, cleaning routines; log abnormalities and coordinate vendors for breakdowns.
  • Track production KPIs: cut accuracy, cycle time, scrap rate, rework, equipment uptime, and order adherence; review variances and implement corrective actions.
  • Implement shopfloor safety practices: PPE usage, safe lifting limits, housekeeping, aisle management, spill control, and immediate escalation of unsafe conditions.
  • Train and mentor helpers/trainees on machine basics, rigging dos/donts, measurement tools, and 5S; conduct quick start-of-shift huddles for plan, risks, and allocation.
  • Collaborate with sales/coordination teams on feasibility, lead times, cutting allowances, and partial dispatches; flag constraints proactively.
  • Complete simple ERP/Excel updates for daily production logs, inventory movements, and cut plans; maintain checklists, service logs, and incident reports.
  • Support vendor interactions: consumables (blades, coolants, slings) replenishment, preventive service scheduling, and quality feedback to suppliers.
  • Uphold fixed working hours, timely payouts process compliance, and disciplined attendance while meeting production and safety targets.
  • Undertake short local runs for company work using the provided two-wheeler when required (documents, small parts, vendor follow-ups).
  • Location: On-site in Kathwada GIDC, Ahmedabad; department: Operations (Steel Yard & Cutting).


Preferred candidate profile

  • Experience track (preferred): 37 years in steel service centers, forging/auto machine shops, or fabrication yards with hands-on bandsaw cutting and EOT crane supervision.
  • Trainee track (also welcome): Freshers or career shifters with strong mechanical aptitude, willingness to learn on the floor, and long-term commitment; full on-the-job training provided.
  • Education: ITI Fitter/Machinist/Turner or Diploma in Mechanical preferred; non-ITI candidates considered if practical skills and learning mindset are evident.
  • Technical competence: Understanding of feed/speed, blade selection, coolant use, and basic maintenance for bandsaws; ability to read tape, vernier, and basic drawings/tolerances.
  • Material handling: Familiarity with rigging, slings/shackles, load balance, and crane signaling; exposure to EOT crane operations is an advantage (training available for trainees).
  • Metallurgy awareness: Ability to differentiate common alloy/carbon steel grades by markings/MTCs; discipline to maintain heat/lot traceability and prevent grade mix-ups.
  • Systems: Comfort with checklists and simple ERP/Excel entries for production, inventory, and dispatch records; documentation accuracy and habit of timely updates.
  • Safety-first attitude: Consistent PPE use, adherence to SOPs, and proactive hazard reporting; clean work habits and 5S orientation.
  • Soft skills: Steady temperament, clear communication with shopfloor teams and drivers, practical problem-solving, and reliability under schedule pressure.
  • Work style: Hands-on supervisor who can both operate and guide; ownership of outcomes, punctuality, and readiness to mentor juniors.
  • Mobility: Comfortable with short local travel on the company-provided two-wheeler for official tasks when needed.
  • Stability and values: Preference for candidates seeking long-term growth, valuing job security, fixed working hours, timely payouts, and performance-linked bonus culture.

Job Description:

Want to be on a team that full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate? Want to make an impact?

At SailPoint, our Engineering team does just that. Our engineering is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our team creates products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS.

SailPoint is seeking a UI Developer to join our engineering team in designing and implementing our cloud based SaaS product. We are looking for well-

rounded full stack developers who are passionate about the front end user experience and have a strong desire to deliver elegant, intuitive web-based UIs for

enterprise applications. You would be a member of a highly Agile team tasked with developing new functionality as well as maintaining and supporting the

existing, publicly available product. Specifically, you will help us evolve our front end from extJS to AngularJS and occasionally required to make changes

to our Java/Groovy server. The ideal candidate is self-directed and a fast learner with flexibility and creativity to work on new technologies as well as legacy

components.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement intuitive, maintainable, responsive web application UIs using Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Good knowledge of Storybook
  • Hands on experience on writing Cypress tests
  • Collaborate with peers and UX team on UI and interaction designs while helping shape the UX based on a balance of customer and technical needs
  • Consume supporting REST APIs and interact closely with microservices teams
  • Work with microservice teams to define API contracts and help guide the architecture of backend systems.
  • Instrument, maintain, and analyze tracking metrics collected at various points within the application to identify pain points and guide improvements
  • Respond to customer incidents and troubleshoot root cause of application issues.
  • Own software quality through the implementation of unit, integration, E2E tests, and monitoring of software releases.
  • Contribute to platform architecture design and planning.
  • Serve as a mentor to other engineers in the team and help them develop good technical principles and discipline.
  • Work closely with product management to provide technical input on features and help develop delivery roadmaps
  • Break down engineering work and create estimates based on product requirements.

Requirements:

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent preferred, or relevant work experience
  • 5-6 years of professional software development experience creating cross browser compatible web-based UIs
  • Strong working knowledge of JavaScript, CSS, HTML, JSON, REST, AJAX, XML, HTTP
  • Good knowledge of Storybook.
  • Good to have experience on writing Cypress tests.
  • Experience with JavaScript framework and tooling such as AngularExperience onboarding and mentoring other engineers.
  • Good knowledge of backend architecture and systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience with Angular, TypeScript, NgRx, NodeJS, and NestJS
  • Good knowledge of Storybook
  • Hands on experience on writing Cypress tests
  • Agile/scrum development methodology
  • Familiarity with microservice architecture
  • Familiarity with Amazon Web Services
  • Familiarity with commercial security applications/infrastructure products.

title: QA Engineer I
tagsAndSkills: C#,Automation Testing,.net,API Testing,API,Automation,Software testing,Quality assurance
jobDescription:
About TripStack: We're a team of travel tech entrepreneurs, changing how millions of people travel. Our proprietary virtual interlining technology provides access to billions of travel itineraries by combining flights from different airline carriers that don't traditionally work together. We take our customers from point A to B via C, including land transportation, at the lowest possible price. We are a part of Etraveli Group, the largest online travel agency (OTA) in Europe, and our biggest partner is Booking.com. We're a performance-driven team that is driven by complex challenges. We're large enough to offer great support but small enough that every individual makes a significant difference.


About Content Acquisition Team - API Integration: At Tripstack, the API integration team develops integrations with various NDC,  LCC, airlines, and consolidator APIs using Tripstacks Technology platform to acquire flight content. These integrations provide essential flight booking and post-booking capabilities to Tripstack platform, which are key drivers for Tripstacks business and offerings to OTA customers.


The Role: As a QA Engineer-II, you will be responsible for end-to-end quality assurance of API Integration where you will be expected to automate the QA. You will report to the team lead and will be an integral part of the development team. We are looking for a self-motivated, and talented individual to help us raise the bar on Quality. The candidate should be a natural problem solver, detail-oriented, and work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.


Role & responsibilities

  • Design and develop tests across the test pyramid: Work with the Airline API development team to ensure the thorough design, development, and execution of end-to-end, and performance testing strategies
  • Responsible for preparing comprehensive test plans, enhancing existing automation frameworks with new test cases, and setting up automated test execution pipelines to enable rapid and continuous feedback.
  • Continuously improve the existing test automation suite
  • Conduct QA tests and verify outcomes within schedules/timelines
  • Own your work: Independently take on a task from start to finish, from initial planning to completion. Own the development and maintenance of test automation solutions for Airlines API Integration
  • Drive testing quality standards and best practices across the team and organization.
  • Actively collaborates with developers, product owners, product managers, product analysts, and QA peers to identify, escalate, and resolve product-related issues, ambiguities, or blockers that impact testing, functionality, or user experience
  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, and contribute to discussions on test strategy
  • Contribute to the analysis and design of both functional and non-functional requirements and technical plans
  • Collaborate: Active participation in scrum ceremonies (grooming, planning, retrospectives, and stand-ups).
  • Develop end to end understanding of features supported by Tripstack's client facing API.
  • Collaborate with developers, POs, and PMs to understand requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Effectively communicate and address scope changes that may impact testing.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Design, develop, and execute automated API test cases using tools such as ReadyAPI and JMeter.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, and performance testing for REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with Docker containers, Wiremock, Allure, Refit.
  • Hands-on experience with any one API testing tool (e.g., ReadyAPI, SOAP UI).
  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming language (C# or Java).
  • Knowledge of creating performance test cases in any of the tools (e.g., JMeter).
  • Ability to understand the business logic of APIs and locate real user scenarios.
  • Ability to design tests that are relevant for API.
  • Strong fundamentals in Algorithms, OOPs, and Data Structures.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs using Jira, and document QA processes in Confluence.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.
  • Proficiency with Git source control tools (e.g., Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab).
  • 2+ years of experience in QA.

Good to Have:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science.
  • Experience with Agile development.
  • Experience in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS).
  • Familiarity with tools like Postman, Fiddler, or Swagger.
  • Understanding of Elastic tools like Kibana or Grafana.
  • Experience with code review tools like SonarQube.
  • Experience with automated CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Prior experience in the travel industry (OTA, airline systems).


Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication.
  • Collaborative mindset with attention to detail.
  • Ability to take ownership and drive tasks to completion.

You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.

Your future at Kyndryl

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

  • Enhanced capabilities in managing statutory audits and internal controls.
  • Development of leadership and mentoring skills in a diverse team environment.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Prepare cost estimates based on material, process, tooling, and overhead costs.
  • Develop competitive quotations with justifications and submit them to customers.
  • Identify and develop vendors if required for toolings and fixtures.
  • Ensure cost-effective manufacturing while maintaining quality standards.

4. APQP, PPAP & Documentation (IATF 16949):

  • Lead Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) for new projects.
  • Develop and maintain Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, Work Instructions, and other quality documents.
  • Conduct and oversee Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) for risk assessment.
  • Prepare and maintain complete PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation.
  • Conduct FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), MSA (Measurement System Analysis), and SPC (Statistical Process Control) to improve process robustness.
  • Prepare detailed process documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, VDA 6.3, and ISO 9001 requirements.
  • Support customer audits and drive corrective actions for quality improvement.

5. Sample Submission & Validation:

6. Cross-Functional Coordination & Customer Interaction:

7. Continuous Improvement & Compliance:

jobDescription:
Job Title: Artwork Production Specialist
Work Location: Mumbai HO
I. Position Summary
The primary purpose of this position is to lead the pack across the physical and digital world. This includes the management of the adaptive design process using agencies from the adaptive design roster. Working with the print management agency, leading the creation and approval of packaging artwork, including separations, which are handed over to the printer in a timely manner. With the partners, lead the creation of CGI pack images and orchestration of product content for the omnichannel environment using Unilever s product management workflow system.
This person will be responsible for initiating and managing projects using the artwork management system and is responsible for overseeing the production, storage and availability of artwork and pack images for usage through the digital channels. The Artwork production specialist will interact with internal teams (Marketing, RD, Supply Chain, E-commerce) who provide master design files and pack content, and external partners (print management agencies, design agencies, printers) who deliver the work in the form of mechanical artwork, pack image albums and printed packaging. The role will orchestrate data, making it available for usage downstream in the E-commerce environment and other channels.
As technical experts, the Artwork Production Specialist will provide expertise in the end-to-end management of the pack to marketing and E-commerce teams by taking responsibility for the creation of artwork and digital pack images to be used in various channels and touchpoints internally and externally in an ever-more digital and connected world.
This role is based in India and will manage work for the ANZ (Australia and New Zealand) market. All collaboration and communication will be conducted online via Microsoft Teams, requiring strong virtual collaboration skills and flexibility to work across time zones.
II. Position Responsibilities (Expected Work)
  • Lead the pack for the end-to-end process from adaptive design / artwork / separation / digital images.
  • Understand the Category and Brands you are working on, Brand DNA guidelines, and plans
  • Work with adaptive design agencies from the agency roster, ensuring that the marketing brief to these agencies is clear. Previews from the adaptive agency to ensure that this meets the expectations of marketing.
  • Collaborate with marketing and design agencies at the design phase, providing expert guidance and technical inputs to ensure that the design is technically printable before the artwork phase.
  • Lead the adaptive design process, including SKU matrix development, technical printability assessment, and toolbox creation by the strategic agency.
  • Understand the artwork process, roles and responsibilities, and how to fit this into the innovation project management process to deliver projects on time and in full. Work on the artwork management system to deliver this.
  • Provide forecasts for artwork and pack image priorities to the PMA using the tools provided.
  • Ensure that the print management agency follows the approved rate cards and service level agreements, and that marketing has visibility on costs
  • Lead the actions with the PMA that the artwork is optimized for cost, e.g., print process, number of colours, and Design for value.
  • Understand the digital and connected word program in Unilever, and the Artwork Excellence role to manage the delivery of digital pack images following the Artwork Excellence process, to the right quality and on time
  • Understanding of CGI technology and the creation of FOP, BOP, and Hero images, and how this is used in a connected and omnichannel world.
  • Executes purpose on pack from a brand and technology perspective.
  • Manage all communications and project coordination virtually using Microsoft Teams.
  • Ensure timely updates and collaboration with ANZ stakeholders despite time zone differences.
  • Maintain high responsiveness and accountability in a remote working setup.
III. Challenges
  • Coordinating multiple projects simultaneously; working with various cross-functional team members as well as multiple external stakeholders at the same time.
  • Work through a multi-cultural environment and collaborate with people and partners across many different countries, often requiring working in different time zones.
  • Managing artwork in a continuously changing environment, where timelines are always tight and artwork is always on the critical path for delivery. Delivering this on time and efficiently.
  • Working with a process and online system that requires discipline from others.
  • Managing the external vendor s compliance within agreed lead time and quality of delivery, compliance with the rate card and processes, particularly when they are not co-located in the same country.
  • Influencing the improvement to artwork management efficiency through project management, process compliance, visibility of artwork KPI, and ways of working within the team.
  • Functioning as a technical expert and business partner to Marketing and other functional teams from design to artwork to the print phase of the process.
  • Skills and expertise in the end-to-end process of design to digital.
  • Design skills to brief, assess, and communicate with adaptive agencies
  • Pack image technical and creative skills to approve images in an omnichannel connected world environment
  • Managing remote collaboration effectively using Microsoft Teams.
  • Navigating time zone challenges and ensuring seamless communication with ANZ teams.
IV. Scope
  • The scope of the role covers adaptive design, artwork, print management, and digital image creation responsibilities and the orchestration of product data.
  • This position can be responsible for several brands and categories at the same time. This may be across market clusters or countries.
  • There is no central time zone, and therefore, the position may have to work in several different environments.
  • The individual must also coordinate multiple external vendors, possibly within other time zones.
  • This will require interaction with many departments to manage all projects as per the artwork process.
  • The role is based in India and will manage projects for the ANZ market through virtual collaboration tools.
V. Skills (what) Competencies (how)
Key Competencies:
  • Min 5 years of work experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships
  • Hold people accountable
  • Good organizational awareness
  • Strong at influencing
  • Negotiating skills
  • Business Partner mindset (not Customer Service)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Teams and other online collaboration tools
  • Ability to work independently and manage remote projects
  • Flexibility to work across time zones and adapt to virtual team dynamics

Job Summary:

The Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily operations related to the production, assembly, or servicing of oilfield equipment and tools. This role ensures production targets are met while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and efficiency. The supervisor coordinates personnel, equipment, and processes to support field operations and workshop activities in compliance with company and industry standards.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Supervise daily production activities in the workshop or field base, including tool assembly, maintenance, and repair of oilfield equipment (e.g., downhole tools, pumps, BOPs, etc.).
  • Coordinate manpower, equipment, and materials to meet production and service delivery requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations, company policies, and industry best practices.
  • Monitor workflow, prioritize jobs, and resolve production issues to avoid downtime or delays.
  • Work closely with field service teams to support operational needs and ensure timely equipment readiness.
  • Oversee quality control checks and ensure all equipment meets required standards before dispatch.
  • Maintain accurate records of production output, inventory, tool usage, and maintenance logs.
  • Train and mentor technicians and production staff on procedures, safety protocols, and quality requirements.
  • Coordinate with supply chain and logistics to ensure timely availability of spare parts and consumables.
  • Participate in audits, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications and Skills


  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in oilfield services or oil & gas operations, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role.
  • Strong knowledge of oilfield equipment, tools, and servicing procedures.
  • Familiarity with safety regulations (e.g., OSHA, API, ISO, or equivalent).
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and work orders.

Preferred Qualifications:


  1. Certifications in H2S, First Aid, or RigPass/Safe Land.
  2. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement tools.
  3. Experience with pressure testing, redressing tools, or maintenance of specialized oilfield equipment.

Work Environment:


  • Workshop and yard-based, with occasional visits to field locations.
  • Exposure to oilfield equipment, machinery, and hazardous materials.
  • PPE required; must adhere strictly to safety protocols.
  • May require working in shifts or on-call based on operational demands.

  • Review pressure part layout as per process data sheet and in accordance with engineering standards and manufacturing/ layout requirement.
  • Design boiler pressure parts according to relevant codes and standards (e.g., IBR, ASME, EN).
  • Review & guide stress analysis and related calculations to ensure component integrity under various operating and transient conditions.
  • Review of appropriate materials for pressure parts based on temperature, pressure, creep and manufacturability requirements.
  • Review and validate detailed fabrication drawings, bill of materials and specifications for accuracy, completeness and constructability.
  • Develop and maintain design basis documents, ensuring alignment with project specifications and regulatory standards.
  • Compliance & Safety:
  • Ensure design compliance with applicable safety regulations, statutory requirements and industry standards (like IBR), international code and environmental policies.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve design-related issues arising during manufacturing, installation, commissioning, or plant operation.
  • Documentation & Reporting:

  • Participate in HAZOP/safety reviews, layout review meetings and technical discussions/ clarifications with manufacturers and other equipment OEMs.
  • Facilitate the review and approval of system-level documentation, including P&IDs, equipment datasheets, GA drawings, system descriptions and logic diagrams.
  • Documenting design changes and modifications:

title: Lead - Quality Assurance Boiler Area
tagsAndSkills: QAPs,Power Plant,MQPs,PT,ASME,MT,NBIC,WPS
jobDescription:
• Role Summary

Manage and execute all Quality Assurance and Control (QA/QC) functions for the Boiler package, covering pressure parts, structural elements, ducting, instrumentations, BOIs and auxiliaries. The role includes planning, implementation, and monitoring of quality activities during engineering reviews, manufacturing at shop/vendor works and site erection phases. The incumbent will interface with engineering, manufacturing, procurement, site and inspection agencies to ensure compliance with QAPs, Manufacturing Quality Plans (MQPs), Field Quality Plans (FQPs), Welding Procedure Specification (WPS) and statutory regulations (such as IBR). Proficient with the Metallurgies utilized in Ultra-Supercritical Technology.

He will function as the single point of contact for all Boiler-related quality matters across project stages and would report to the Head of QA.

  • Key Responsibilities:
  • QAP/FQP Implementation & Monitoring
  • Develop, review and implement QAPs, MQPs, FQPs and WPS for Boiler systems in coordination with Engineering team, OEMs (for auxiliaries and BOIs) and the other members of the central QA team.
  • Ensure that all inspections and hold points are adhered to as per the approved plans.
  • Identify quality control checkpoints and ensure rigorous compliance at each stage.
  • Manufacturing & Vendor Quality Oversight
  • Monitor manufacturing quality at in-house facility (for headers, coils, drums, panels, etc.) and vendor facilities (for Structures, BOIs, etc.).
  • Coordinate with in-house QC team and third-party inspection agencies to ensure timely inspections and clearances.
  • Validate vendor PQRs for welding-related works; ensure welder qualifications are in place.
  • Site Quality Management
  • Coordinate with Site Quality team for QA/QC activities during erection & assembly of Boiler components.
  • Coordinate with erection contractors, site engineers and third-party inspectors for timely inspection and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with IBR, ASME and project-specific requirements during pressure part installation and testing.
  • Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions
  • Ensure identification and reporting of non-conformities; lead Root Cause Analysis and ensure closure with corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Maintain NCR logs and ensure their timely resolution and documentation.
  • Coordination & Interface
  • Work closely with Engineering, Procurement and Project Execution teams to resolve quality issues and drive design conformance.
  • Attend client/consultant review meetings and support audits pertaining to Boiler quality.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Ensure proper documentation and traceability of all inspection records, material certificates, and test reports.
  • Maintain up-to-date quality dossiers for Boiler system.
  • Provide support to Head QA and to Project Management team for ensuring Quality Management of Boiler Area.
  • Experience & Expertise:
  • Strong experience in QA/QC of Boiler systems in large-scale thermal Supercritical and Ultra-supercritical power projects along-with in-depth understanding of QA/QC processes for Manufacturing of Boiler Components and Equipment.
  • Hands-on expertise in pressure part fabrication, welding processes and IBR compliance.
  • Proficient with Metallurgies utilized in Ultra-Supercritical Technology.
  • Familiarity with relevant standards: IBR, ASME, IS, ISO Standards.
  • Experience in managing third-party inspection agencies, vendors, and erection contractors.
  • Proficiency in preparing and executing QAPs, Welding Procedure Specification (WPS)/PQRs and inspection checklists.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills; experience in quality dashboards/tools is desirable.
  • Experience with digital quality tools, inspection software and quality reporting dashboards is desirable.
  • Educational Qualifications:
  • B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized university.
  • IBR Competency
  • Postgraduate diploma or certification in Quality Assurance / Welding Technology (desirable).
  • Certifications (preferred):
  • ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor
  • NDT Level II (RT, UT, PT, MT)
  • ASME / NBIC exposure

About ADVANZ PHARMA
ADVANZ PHARMA is a global pharmaceutical company with the purpose to improve patients lives by providing and enhancing the specialty, hospital, and rare disease medicines they depend on.

Our Centre of Excellence in Mumbai, India, as well as an established global distribution and commercialisation partner network, complements our global operations.
ADVANZ PHARMA s product portfolio and pipeline comprises innovative medicines, specialty generics biosimilars, and originator brands. Our products and pipeline cover a broad range of therapeutic areas, including hepatology, gastroenterology, anti-infectives, critical care, endocrinology, CNS, and, more broadly, rare diseases.
We can only achieve our ambition with the passion of our dedicated and highly qualified people, acting in line with our company values of entrepreneurship, speed, and integrity.

The Senior Project Manager role will assume overall project management responsibility for the delivery of technology transfer (site transfer), API change, reformulation, RFQ, and process improvement projects.   • Thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and take accountability for results.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building and optimizing ML models and working with large datasets, with experience in fine-tuning generative AI models and familiarity with Azure cloud platforms as a plus.   • Model Training & Evaluation: Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models to achieve high accuracy, scalability, and robustness, using metrics relevant to sports applications.
  • Collaboration: Work with sports analysts, data engineers, and domain experts across India, the UK, Singapore, and the Middle East to incorporate domain knowledge into Aiko and align with business objectives.
  • Deployment & Optimization: Deploy models into production environments, preferably leveraging Azure cloud platforms, ensuring efficient inference for real-time or near-real-time sports applications.

  • Documentation: Document model architectures, fine-tuning processes, evaluation frameworks, and performance metrics for reproducibility and knowledge sharing.

Experience:

  • 5+ years in AI/ML engineering, with significant experience in conventional ML.
  • Proven expertise in building ML models (e.g., Scikit-learn, XGBoost).
  • Experience with fine-tuning generative AI models (e.g., Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus but not mandatory.
  • Previous experience with sports-related datasets, particularly Cricket or Football, is a plus but not mandatory.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Strong knowledge of conventional ML algorithms (e.g., regression, decision trees, SVMs) and familiarity with generative AI architectures (e.g., transformers, GANs).
  • Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and handling large datasets.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms for model training and deployment, with Azure experience as a strong plus.
  • Knowledge of MLOps practices, including model versioning, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with computer vision, natural language processing, or text generation is a plus.
  • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with Cricket or Football analytics, biomechanics, or performance metrics is an advantage but not required.
  • Soft Skills:
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional and global teamwork.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience fine-tuning large language models or generative AI for domain-specific applications.
  • Experience developing evaluation frameworks for generative AI models.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud services (e.g., Azure Machine Learning, Azure Kubernetes Service, or Azure Data Lake) for model development and deployment.
  • Experience with real-time or streaming data for sports applications.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning or multimodal AI models.

This role sits at the intersection of two critical pieces of our fundraising strategy:
  1. Building U&I s readiness and capacity for philanthropic grants, and

jobDescription:

About us

_x000D_

_x000D_

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net-zero future. As one of the world s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

_x000D_

_x000D_

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society s evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together .

_x000D_
ExxonMobil s affiliates in India _x000D_

ExxonMobil s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

ExxonMobil s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

ExxonMobil s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.


The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil s operations around the globe.


ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.


To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India .

What role you will play in our team _x000D_

If you like working in a team where people take care of each other, where people are honest with each other, where we give honest feedback and like to receive honest feedback. We may have a great job for you!

ExxonMobil is seeking qualified and experienced individuals to provide oilfield chemistry technical support and expertise to its oil and gas production, refining and chemicals operations and projects. The candidate would be part of ExxonMobils Materials Engineering team in ExxonMobil Technology and Engineering Company, working out of ExxonMobils Bengaluru Campus (Prestige Shantiniketan) in India. The candidate would be responsible for working with multi-discipline teams to execute/establish/improve oilfield chemistry related work processes/solutions/ recommendations.

You will be leading the development, execution and optimization of global Oilfield Chemical (OFC) programs inclusive of asset integrity, flow assurance and production/process optimization. Primary responsibilities include identification and management of downside risks and upside opportunities related to inorganic scale, wax, asphaltenes, corrosion, biological growth, calcium naphthenates, emulsions, oxygen and H2S scavengers, hydrates in the production operation and water treatment.

What you will do _x000D_

  • Develop technical scope of work and define associated chemical requirements for evaluation and selection of new/replacement oilfield chemicals including safety, environmental impact, and performance effects.
  • Develop and optimize chemical treatment programs and methods to meet asset integrity and production goals.
  • Participate in designing the matrix and protocol for Oil field chemical lab qualification. Interpret data and participate in technology transfers.
  • Develop and optimize chemical monitoring programs to monitor/surveillance both chemical delivery and chemical performance for integrity, flow assurance and process for oil and gas production, water injection, utilities and produced water re-injection and disposal.
  • Serve as Oilfield Chemicals Subject Matter Expert (SME) and engage with chemical supplier personnel to review proposals and provide revised/new recommendations as needed.
  • Lead and coordinate interfaces between asset engineering and operations teams, chemical suppliers, procurement, and project teams to converge on optimized chemical program solutions, troubleshoot and support management of change as needed.
  • Lead the design, execution, and analysis of field validation trials and pilot programs for new or optimized chemical treatments, ensuring alignment with operational KPIs and regulatory standards.
  • Develop and optimize tools, templates, procedures, etc. underpinning the work area. Support implementation of digitalization and implement methods to better visualize program effectiveness and cost management.
  • Leverage global SME network, and steward lessons learned and knowledge management platforms. Transfer lessons learned and best practices across sites.
  • Lead/Participate in TSA (Total System Analysis) and CMT (Chemical Management Team) activities. Influencing multi-discipline teams to enhance asset performance.
  • Support planning and budgeting for OFC Program for enhancements in purchasing, logistics, treatment rates, and supply management.
  • Support Contract Administration, reporting, and stewardship activities (i.e., coordinate with contract owner/administrator to steward quarterly meetings, track contract administration KPIs, evaluate chemical contractor performance, provide feedback to contract owner and contractor for improvement, work with contractor to resolve any gaps, etc.,)
  • Provide technical mentoring and continuous on-the-job guidance to develop early career engineers.
  • Continuously stay abreast of latest developments in industry standards/practices, bring in learnings/experience to challenge and improve company work processes/practices, and technology.
  • Influence decision making in OFC research and/or technology development.
About You _x000D_

Skills and Qualifications.

  • Bachelors or masters degree from a recognized university in Chemistry, Chemical engineering, Petroleum engineering or related disciplines.
  • Minimum 8 years of industry experience in Oilfield Chemicals or Specialty Chemical Management or similar role in Oil & Gas industry or Industrial Water treatment industry or similar industries.
  • Demonstrated work experience and technical depth in both aqueous and hydrocarbon chemistry/physics with application to corrosion management, flow assurance, production enhancement, and/or water treatment.
  • Experience in monitoring/surveillance of operating assets to maintain/enhance asset integrity, flow assurance, fluid delivery, and/or facilities/process performance.
  • Familiarity with laboratory methods to test chemical effectiveness, material compatibility, fluids compatibility or other related factors is preferred.
  • Familiarity with chemical injection equipment and systems, and monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with multiple commodities and specialty chemicals such as corrosion inhibitors, biocides, scale inhibitors, paraffin inhibitors, demulsifiers, clarifiers, viscosity reducing agents (VRAs), drag reducing agents (DRAs), pour point depressants (PPDs), foamers, scavengers and anti foamer is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications/Experiences _x000D_

  • Demonstrated initiative and ability to handle multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence with operations and engineering personnel who is directly supporting active sites.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Demonstrated collaboration and teamwork in a multi-disciplinary environment.
  • Work shift is normally in the afternoon shift (01:30 pm to 10:30 pm) with flexibility to meet business needs.
  • Flexibility to both travel internationally and support sites remotely as per business needs.
  • Strong business acumen preferred to drive value realization considering commercial contracts, procurement, supply chain and logistics.
  • Should not have attended an interview for Advanced Oilfield Chemicals Engineer position in the last 1 year at ExxonMobil.

As an Associate Design Engineer, you will be responsible for assisting in mechanical and hydro investigations and design activities for turbomachinery products. This role involves supporting engineering teams in analysing Shop, Field Issues and failures, developing design improvements, and preparing technical documentation for Solar Turbine Packaging systems. Designing packaging systems and equipment layouts.

  • Assist in creating and updating 3D models and 2D drawings using CAD tools (e.g., Creo).

  • Participate in root cause analysis of Shop, Field Issues/failures and performance issues.

  • Prepare and maintain engineering documentation including design reports, investigation summaries.

  • Knowledge on Gas Turbines and Packaging systems components are added advantages.

  • Strong knowledge on material properties and their performance considering offshore Onshore loading conditions
  • Excellent in modelling techniques using Creo parametric / Autodesk
  • Good exposure to the use of Product Lifecycle Management tool Windchill
  • Good Exposure on ASME/API/ISO/ANSI DIN

As a Design Engineer - Package Engineer - Turbomachinery you will be to lead investigations into shop and field failures of Packaging systems of turbomachinery products. This role involves diagnosing mechanical issues, electrical systems and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI) identifying root causes and recommending corrective actions for packaging sub systems. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with failure analysis, and a deep understanding of turbomachinery systems and Field exposure
This role combines hands-on diagnostics, root cause analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to resolve complex issues and drive product reliability improvements.

Responsibilities
  • The candidate should possess a minimum of 7 years of industry experience in engineering / design execution and associated applications. Experience should include significant, demonstrated results leading Mechanical systems design supporting industrial gas turbine packaging and associated gas compression and power generation process and systems engineering and design. In addition, the candidate should demonstrate knowledge of discipline-related industry standards (e.g., ASME, ASTM, ANSI, OSHA) and comprehensive familiarity with PTC applications. Experience with Solar Turbines strongly preferred.

  • Perform hand calculations like pressure drop, Flow path, temperature etc
  • Responsibilities to develop PID for Gas Fuel, Lube Oil, Liquid Fuel, Air Supply, Start, Compressor Seal, Water wash Turbine systems being used in Gas turbines.

  • Develop and maintain endpoint security strategies that align with organizational risk tolerance and industry best practices.

  • Provide and maintain training material and upskill junior engineering staff through remote training in best practice processes and procedures to optimize vulnerability remediation.

Compliance and Governance

  • Work with Security and Compliance teams to ensure endpoint vulnerability management practices comply with relevant regulatory standards such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, or GDPR.

Soft Skills
